rows.name: Aeolus to Cheyenne 230 kV
rows.quote: The Aeolus to Cheyenne 230 kV project consists of two (2) 135-mile 230 kV transmission lines sharing common right-of-way from PacifiCorp’s Aeolus substation to a new substation located southwest of Cheyenne, WY. The project is currently in Phase 1 of the WECC Path Rating Process.
rows.status_raw: currently in Phase 1 of the WECC Path Rating Process

rows.name: Robinson 230 kV Substation
rows.quote: The Robinson 230 kV substation is a new load serving substation tapping the Sweetgrass – West Cheyenne 230 kV line.

rows.name: CLPT-G17 200 MW Solar/Wind/BESS
rows.quote: The CLPT-G17 project is a 200 MW combined solar, wind, and battery generation facility with a planned commercial operation date in 2028.

rows.name: CLPT-G20 365 MW Solar/BESS
rows.quote: The Large Generating Facility shall not exceed 365 MW net output at the point of interconnection which will be a new substation, Holliday, tapping the Bluffs – Sweetgrass 230 kV line near Cheyenne, WY.

rows.name: CLPT-G21 400 MW Solar/BESS
rows.quote: The CLPT-G21 project is a 400 MW combined solar and battery generation facility with a planned commercial operation date in 2028.

rows.name: CPGS – Sweetgrass 230 kV Conversion
rows.quote: The CPGS – Sweetgrass 230 kV Conversion project is converting an existing 115 kV line to 230 kV. This project was identified as mitigation necessary for the CLPT-G21 project listed above. Part of this project is to add a new 230 kV bus to the Cheyenne Prairie Generating Station (CPGS) substation in Cheyenne, WY along with a 200 MVA 230/115 kV transformer.

rows.name: BHCT-G49 200 MW Solar
rows.quote: The Large Generating Facility shall not exceed 200 MW net output at the point of interconnection which will be a new substation, tapping the Reader – Rattlesnake 115 kV south of Pueblo, CO.

rows.name: CLPT-G16 300 MW Solar/Wind/BESS
rows.quote: The Large Generating Facility shall not exceed 300 MW net output at the point of interconnection which will be a new substation, Chugwater, tapping the West Cheyenne – Windstar 230 kV line near Chugwater, WY.

rows.name: CLPT-G18 300 MW Solar/BESS
rows.quote: The Large Generating Facility shall not exceed 300 MW net output at the point of interconnection which will be a new substation, Dutchman, tapping the West Cheyenne – Windstar 230 kV line near Glenrock, WY.

rows.name: Turkey Creek Solar Project
rows.quote: The Turkey Creek Solar project is a 200 MW solar facility consisting of sixty (60) 3.69 MVA photovoltaic inverters with a planned in-service date in 2026. This project is in the Black Hills Colorado Electric (BHCE) service territory near the city of Penrose, Colorado.
